question: Which of the following states has the largest Balance Recoverable Reserves (Onshore) of Crude oil as of 01.04.2019, as per the Indian Petroleum and Natural Gas Statistics, 2018-19?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Assam**__.
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The three largest directors of mineral oil painting or crude oil painting in India are** Rajasthan(23.7)**,** Gujarat(12.5), Assam(12.1)**.
 
• Among these three countries, Assam is the largest patron of **mineral oil painting in India**.
 
• Assam, Gujarat and Rajasthan, which together regard for further than **96 percent of oil painting** from onshore fields, and from the aged coastal Mumbai High Field.
 
• Rajasthan has a share of **about 23.29** in crude oil painting product in the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
